The egg/vegetable casserole piece is about 175 px by 150 px, which is about 12.8 cm by 11 cm. It is irregular, so the footprint is closer to 100 cm². At about 3 cm high that gives roughly 300 cm³, but the shape is uneven, so I take about 60% of that, or 180 cm³. At about 0.9 g/cm³ this is roughly 160 g.

The hash browns cover about 110 px by 130 px, which is about 8 by 9.5 cm. The footprint is roughly 55 cm² at about 2 cm high. That is about 110 cm³ at a loose density of 0.5 g/cm³, so roughly 60 g.

The herb garnish is about 2 g.
